projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.subtitle: Digital products, applications and experiences I have built — from concept to implementation.

items.title: SSDoces
items.description: E-commerce platform for a confectionery brand, including product catalogue, cart, checkout and management areas.
items.problem: The business needed a digital storefront to present products and organize the ordering process.
items.solution: Built an online store experience with search, filters, favourites, persistent cart, checkout, customer area and admin dashboard. The project includes authentication structure and Supabase integration.
items.result: A comprehensive e-commerce foundation with purchase and management flows ready for further production integration.

items.title: PrimeCode
items.description: Agency website for a digital studio focused on web development and tailored solutions for businesses.
items.problem: The agency needed a professional way to present its services and make it easier for prospective clients to get in touch.
items.solution: Built a bilingual website with services, portfolio, FAQ, contact forms and newsletter. Prepared email delivery with Resend and a backend architecture for Vercel deployment.
items.result: A commercial digital presence with PT/EN communication, SEO structure and integrated contact flows.

items.title: Campus OS
items.description: Academic planner for organizing university life, courses, tasks, assessments and study sessions.
items.problem: Academic information and tasks were scattered, making planning and progress tracking harder.
items.solution: Developing an application with an academic calendar, assessments, tasks, study sessions, focus mode, goals and preferences. Its planning engine considers priorities and spaced review.
items.result: An evolving academic platform with persistent operations, calendar rules and tests for date and timezone scenarios.

items.title: PLANNER OS / ARTPLANNER
items.description: Personal management platform designed to bring productivity, studies, tasks, habits and goals into one system.
items.problem: Separate tools make it difficult to manage different areas of life and maintain an integrated view of progress.
items.solution: Structured the product architecture, modules, business rules, data model and visual identity. The technical foundation uses React, TypeScript, Supabase and Vite.
items.result: A documented product foundation under development, with architecture research and a clear direction for integrated modules.

items.title: EuroRail — Reservation Module
items.description: Academic prototype of a travel reservation system, built in Flowgorithm for an Algorithms and Programming course.
items.problem: The task was to model a reservation process with seat availability, seat categories and passenger validation.
items.solution: Modelled seat initialization, availability, seat selection, validation, premium-seat surcharge and reservation confirmation using variables, arrays, loops and conditionals.
items.result: A working prototype tested with one premium reservation. Further work is needed for multiple reservations and additional validation scenarios.

items.title: Premium Real Estate Website
items.description: Real-estate presentation experience with a premium visual approach focused on architecture and properties.
items.problem: Explore a more editorial and sophisticated digital presentation for the real-estate sector.
items.solution: Built a frontend experience with Next.js, React and Motion, focusing on page structure, visual composition and responsive components.
items.result: A showcase project demonstrating premium interface exploration and Next.js development.

items.title: Golden Archways Showcase
items.description: Visual exploration project with a premium identity, graphic composition and modern web interface.
items.problem: Experiment with a distinctive visual language and translate a creative direction into a web experience.
items.solution: Built the interface with the React and TanStack ecosystem, exploring components, structure and visual presentation.
items.result: A showcase experience demonstrating interface work and visual direction.

items.title: Personal Portfolio
items.description: Bilingual portfolio bringing together projects, skills, background, resume and contact channels.
items.problem: Needed a professional presence to present my work and grow alongside new projects.
items.solution: Built the website with dedicated pages, PT/EN content, animations, technical SEO, downloadable resume and responsive navigation.
items.result: A published personal platform ready to feature new projects and case studies.
